method: Each ayah is a vector of the roots it contains weighted by rarity (idf = ln(6236/df)), and a link is the cosine between two ayah vectors: every ayah keeps its 8 strongest links with score > 0 (equal scores go to the earlier ayah), each with up to 5 shared roots, rarest first.
format: lNNN.json = {n, ayat: [[[s, a, score, [rootId, ...]], ...], ...]}; rootId = index in roots.json + 1
